person.name: Destan Guler
person.headline: I'm Destan Guler, a narrative consultant and writer based in Tokyo.
person.intro: Destan Guler — Narrative Consultant & Writer based in Tokyo. Brand stories, screenplays, and creative collaborations.
person.aboutHeadline: I write stories and help bring them to the screen.
biography: My background is in digital marketing, content production, and narrative writing. I've worked on brand campaigns and video productions, including Red Bull Gamerszon as a Content Creator & Assistant Producer.
I started writing poems as a kid and screenplays at university. That interest grew into work on production sets. Games, films, books, and series still shape the way I think about stories.
